name: R&Q Insurance Holdings Ltd.
summary: R&Q Insurance Holdings Ltd. is a specialized non-life insurance enterprise primarily active across the United States and Europe. The company focuses on purchasing books of non-life business that are no longer actively underwriting new policies, as well as acquiring non-life insurance firms and captive insurers that are in run-off. It offers a range of exit and restructuring solutions for insurance operations, which include direct acquisitions, transferring portfolios, engaging in reinsurance, facilitating insurance business transfers, and providing policies for self-insured retentions (SIR) or deductible reimbursements. Additionally, R&Q delivers program management services. The company also serves as an intermediary, connecting Managing General Agents (MGAs) and other niche underwriters with appropriate capital providers. Founded in 1991, and headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda, the organization adopted its current name, R&Q Insurance Holdings Ltd., in July 2022, having previously been known as Randall & Quilter Investment Holdings Ltd.
